findings.summary: NotifyOnExit has a liveness-to-subscribe race that can miss owner death and leave VFS-owned state stale.
findings.fix: Subscribe while holding SCHEDULER or recheck liveness atomically inside subscribe_death.

findings.summary: VFS send completion releases leases but leaves current_caller context active for later stale GrantSlice authorization.
findings.fix: Clear the VFS task caller context after the send/release terminal point and add a post-reply denial regression.

verification.evidence: unwinding panics are not supported without std
